name: Ananya Rao
headline: Senior Product Manager, B2B SaaS
summary: Product manager with 7 years building B2B SaaS for finance and operations teams. Took two products from zero to ₹40 Cr ARR by pairing customer research with fast, measured experiments.

bullets: Led the invoicing product from beta to 2,300 paying businesses, growing ARR from ₹6 Cr to ₹24 Cr in 2 years
Cut onboarding time from 9 days to 2 by redesigning setup around bank-feed imports
Built a pricing experiment framework; 3 tests lifted average contract value by 18%
Hired and coached a team of 4 PMs and 2 designers
Launched a carrier-rate API used by 400 merchants within 6 months
Reduced failed deliveries by 22% with address validation at checkout
Ran 60+ customer interviews to shape the roadmap for the SMB segment
Modelled working-capital savings of ₹12 Cr for a retail client's supply chain
Automated weekly reporting in SQL and Python, saving 15 analyst hours a week

paragraphs: Paybright is building the payments layer Indian SMBs have been missing, and the Group Product Manager role sits exactly where my last seven years have been: invoicing, payments and the operations teams who use them.

At Ledgerly I took our invoicing product from beta to 2,300 paying businesses and grew ARR from ₹6 Cr to ₹24 Cr in two years. The biggest lever was onboarding: by rebuilding setup around bank-feed imports we cut it from 9 days to 2, which mattered more than any feature we shipped that year.

I also built the pricing experiment framework behind an 18% lift in average contract value, and I coach a team of 4 PMs and 2 designers. At Shipwise I learned how merchants judge payment and delivery reliability, launching a carrier-rate API used by 400 merchants.
I would like to bring that mix of customer research, measured experiments and team building to Paybright's SMB payments roadmap. I would welcome a conversation about where the team is headed next.
